sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-3B Home Assistant (German, GGUF) Built with Qwen. LoRA fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct that controls a Home Assistant installation in German via tool calls and answers questions about device states. Quantized to Q4_K_M (1.9 GB) for CPU inference with llama.cpp.
